thread:
Nina (People Ops): quick recap from today's all-hands Q&A: posted recording + condensed FAQ. dropping the key takeaways here for anyone who couldn't make it.
Eli (Eng): thanks! can you confirm the promotion effective date if approvals finish mid-month?
Nina (People Ops): yes 1: promotions/raises take effect on the first day of the month after approvals complete (unless payroll needs retro).
Sara (SWE): is the 6-month tenure requirement by cycle close or by effective date?
Nina (People Ops): tenure = 6 months by cycle close (the date in the schedule). exceptions for transfers/contractors handled manually.
Omar (Manager): about calibration docs: do we need peer feedback for every case?
Nina (People Ops): peer feedback is recommended but not required. include if it strengthens the case. minimal required fields noted in the notes doc.
Comp Bot: FYI: comp pool guidance emailed to managers yesterday. Link in thread.
Eli (Eng): appeals process? a teammate is worried about missing evidence.
Nina (People Ops): appeals allowed once per cycle: manager + IC discuss, submit appeals form within 7 business days. panel reviews within 10 business days.
Sara (SWE): any change to leveling rubric?
Nina (People Ops): updated rubric v2 live 1: clearer impact examples and manager vs IC expectations. see internal link in notes.
Nina (People Ops): i'll post a one-page manager checklist in #announcements and follow up with managers directly. DM me for 1:1s or edge cases.Thanks!
